subject: Proposed Senate Bill S993 Preservation Impacts
overview: The Commission scheduled a neighborhood site visit for the South Street district and approved a joint session with the Historical Commission to initiate a citywide preservation plan. Members also reviewed proposed state housing legislation and agreed to draft a formal letter of concern regarding provisions that would curtail local authority to protect historic structures from demolition.

items.title: Meeting Minutes
items.summary: Postponed the approval of previous meeting minutes until the following month.

items.title: South Street Site Visit and Signage
items.summary: Scheduled a public site visit to the South Street district for September 16 to identify appropriate locations for permanent historic signage.

items.title: Joint Meeting for Citywide Preservation Plan
items.summary: Approved a motion to hold a joint public meeting with the Historical Commission to discuss developing a comprehensive preservation plan to protect vulnerable historic assets from redevelopment.

items.title: Review of Senate Bill S993
items.summary: Discussed drafting a letter to state legislators expressing concern that the proposed housing production bill would strip the commission of its jurisdiction to prevent the demolition of historic structures like carriage houses. Members argued the bill as written would be burdensome to administer and would undermine the integrity of established historic districts for minimal housing gains.
